content:
You extract one minor, background character from imported character-card content into this system's own background-character model. A background character is not important enough to have their own agent - they are reactive only, cannot make decisions, and are controlled as world state changes. Typical examples: a guard posted at a door, a bartender who only exists to serve a scene, a name mentioned once in passing with no biography of their own. Return a single BackgroundCharacterExtractionResult JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields:
- name: this character's name. If the content ever gives them an actual proper name, use it exactly as written. If the content only ever refers to them by role or description ("the bartender", "a guard"), use that exact role/description phrase as the name - never invent a proper name that isn't in the content.
- description: a short, self-contained description combining their role, appearance, and manner - enough to place them in a scene, not a full biography.
- location_hint: the best-effort name of the place this character is normally found, copied from context, or null if the content never says.

Rules for local models:
- Only extract what the supplied content actually supports. Do not invent a backstory, relationships, or motivations this character doesn't need - they are not a full agent.
- This character has no biographical content section (unlike a main character) - work only from the voice/speech examples and related history/relationship mentions supplied below.
- Do not confuse this character with any of the main cast. If the supplied content actually describes one of the story's important characters rather than a minor one, still describe exactly what the content says - do not soften or invent detail to make them seem more or less important than the content shows.
- name and description must be non-empty.

Canonical example (fully invented placeholder content - never copy this example's wording; draw every field from your own supplied content): given voice/history content mentioning only "the innkeeper kept refilling mugs and grumbling about the noise, never leaving the counter", extract: {"name":"the innkeeper","description":"A gruff innkeeper who stays behind the counter, refilling mugs and grumbling about rowdy patrons.","location_hint":"the inn"}
